purpose: Attach federated company/contact identity to CRM read models without changing source ownership.
rules: CRM keeps its own contact/account identifiers for commercial continuity.
identity_contact_id and identity_company_id are federation references, not replacements for source IDs.
Resolved identity may be used for cross-service joins.
Provisional identity remains explicitly marked and reviewable.
No resolver call writes to Navigator, WCA or any other source system.
